listing.name: Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition / Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition Recomp (sonsegajp)
listing.summary: An experimental Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition project translating AArch64 code to C for a Windows x64 Vulkan player with custom kernel/services. It reads original NSO segments and data from your own package and claims no CPU JIT. The project reports startup, menus, movies, Adventure/Legend battles, saves and audio in test prereleases; these are not independent play observations. Windows 10/11 x64 needs AVX2 and Vulkan 1.2; movies require MediaFoundation, with the extra feature pack on N editions. Source builds generate C from your dump, but release instructions only provide NSP/keys and do not establish first-run code generation. Use your own base NSP title 0100AE00096EA000 and prod.keys; it decrypts ExeFS/RomFS directly. Exact base revision/region/hashes and firmware/fonts are unconfirmed. The separate musoh 1.0.1 profile is not interchangeable. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
